usedFor: Roborabbit runs your browser tasks, and Documint writes up the result when “Run Finished” runs “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “Run Finished” in Roborabbit, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A finished run fills a document template, giving you a report without copying results by hand.

watchOut: “Run Finished” is polling, so the Documint template fills after a scheduled check.
